about: YOUR REVIEW IN FIVE (5 Nov 2026, Michael): a student feels he knows the task when he holds its shape in his head: one introduction, three body phrases (two features and a drawback), one recommendation. One core phrase per slot; two more ways to say it unlock once he owns the slot (recalled on two different days); any slot may be his own sentence if it does the slot's job. {X} = the name he types, {a} = a/an + the kind of thing, {plural} = the kind, plural. 'hide' = the word shown as its first letter. v3 (5 Nov): each slot climbs a ladder of five steps, one a day at most: 1 Select (which one does this job?), 2 Match halves, 3 Sort the pieces, 4 Gap-fill (three words, first letters given), 5 From memory (only the job shown). Top of the ladder = the slot is his. 'q' = the Select question; 'picks' = one-tap names. · 25 Nov 2026 (the owner, after the content check): every way is a phrase the task's own model texts use (the Model and Guided/Sample steps), three alternatives per move, the moves in the models' order, so Basics teaches what the practice shows. · 'example' on a subject: the five sentences finished for its first answer (eg), each starting with its move's first way; Basics shows them on its card (25 Nov 2026, the owner: immediately likeable).
name: Review

subjects.label: A game
subjects.ask: the music? the levels? the characters?
subjects.askBad: the price? the ads? the waiting?
example: If you are looking for a relaxing game, Stardew Valley is perfect.
The first thing that strikes you is the beautiful, colourful farm.
What really sets Stardew Valley apart is that you can play at your own speed.
I would not hesitate to recommend Stardew Valley to anyone who needs a break.
It is, without doubt, the most relaxing game I have ever played.

subjects.label: A series
subjects.ask: the story? the actors? the ending?
subjects.askBad: the slow start? the long wait? the ending?
example: If you are looking for a series to watch with friends, Stranger Things is ideal.
The first thing that strikes you is the brilliant young actors.
What really sets Stranger Things apart is the mix of fear and friendship.
I would not hesitate to recommend Stranger Things to anyone over twelve.
It is, without doubt, the most exciting series I have seen this year.

subjects.label: Social media
subjects.ask: the videos? the filters? the people you follow?
subjects.askBad: the ads? the time it eats? the rude comments?
example: If you are looking for an app to share your photos, Instagram is the obvious choice.
The first thing that strikes you is how easy it is to use.
What really sets Instagram apart is its creative filters.
I would not hesitate to recommend Instagram to anyone who loves photography.
It is, without doubt, the most popular app among my friends.

It is, without doubt, the most delicious meal I have had this year.
